facts.fact: The Sierra Leone Standards Bureau states that its Standards Department develops and publishes national standards under the Standards Act No. 2 of 1996, and that it has published 204 national standards in the public gazette; it names a technical committee on Information Security Management Systems but no national IT or data standard issued; published date used because the page gives no event date.

note: No certification fact: a headline on the page mentions a management system certification body (MSCB) launch, with no date, standard or certifier detail.
